Method: official directory plus date-specific web query site:aaem.org/topic/position/ "April" "2025" ; route: public indexed site search / official HTML. Primary: https://www.aaem.org/topic/position/. Outcome: Official dated AAEM position archive and April-date query checked. AAEM malpractice-insurance contract standards were board-approved April 10 (https://www.aaem.org/statements/malpractice-coverage/), but address employment coverage rather than bedside clinical management; April 25 safe-staffing statement is outside the window. No additional ED clinical policy in April 6–12 found.

Method: official directory plus date-specific web query site:publications.aap.org/pediatrics "April" "2025" "Clinical Practice Guideline" emergency ; route: public indexed site search / official HTML. Primary: https://publications.aap.org/aapbooks/book/785/Pediatric-Clinical-Practice-Guidelines-amp. Outcome: AAP official April 2025 guidelines/policies collection was checked; it republishes policies only through December 2024 and is not a new April 2025 recommendation. Targeted AAP/Pediatrics date search found no newly first-online April 6–12 ED pediatric policy; 2026 pediatric-readiness policy is later. Search limited to accessible AAP listings and date results.

Method: official directory plus date-specific web query site:acc.org/Guidelines "April" "2025" "April 6" OR "April 12" ; route: public indexed site search / official HTML. Primary: https://www.acc.org/Guidelines. Outcome: ACC official guideline directory/date-specific search checked. Major 2025 ACC/AHA/ACEP acute coronary syndrome guideline was public April 3, BEFORE the window (official ACC source), not an April 6–12 new guideline. No further in-window ED-relevant ACC clinical update identified in results screened; negative search is limited to the accessible official directory and date query.

Method: official directory plus date-specific web query site:acep.org/patient-care/clinical-policies OR site:acepnow.com/category/clinical-policy/ "April" "2025" clinical policy ED ; route: public indexed site search / official HTML. Primary: https://www.acepnow.com/category/clinical-policy/. Outcome: Official ACEP Now policy index and January 22 approval plus May 7 discussion of carbon-monoxide policy reviewed (PMID 40118649; ACEP primary PDF https://www.acep.org/siteassets/sites/acep/media/clinical-policies/final-cp-pdfs/carbonmonoxide3-cp.pdf). PubMed's print issue is April and bibliographic record was imported March 22, but an authoritative exact FIRST PUBLIC online date remains unverified. No April 6–12 policy is asserted; date-sensitive policy reconciliation remains open.

ESTES polytrauma consensus (PMID 40214785, first online Apr 11) already saved independently. No additional high-priority EAST trauma bedside guidance verified in accessible April-date search.

finalCrossCheck: Emergency-medicine RCTs: 82 unique cached candidates screened ordinal 1–82; WESTCOR first online April 9 retained; 80-person sham-controlled TENS back-pain RCT (PMID 40202296) improved short-term pain but small and not practice changing.

NEJM/JAMA/Lancet/BMJ acute-care trials: ten cached general-journal memberships screened; MS disease-modification papers and editorials excluded as not acute-care ED trials; no further qualifying in-window major RCT verified.

ACEP policies: ACEP policy index and primary CO-policy PDF checked. Carbon-monoxide policy approved January 22, PubMed April print issue and imported March 22, but exact first PUBLIC electronic posting remains unconfirmed; do not assign to this window. Keep ACEP check incomplete.

AHA/ASA statements: targeted official professional.heart.org April 6–12 date search found no independently verified new acute stroke or cardiac emergency statement; source check incomplete pending additional dated guidance index resolution.

SCCM/sepsis: official SCCM guidelines index checked; February CCUS and heat-stroke guidance and later 2026 sepsis guidance are outside interval; bounded negative clinical search supports no selected in-window SCCM guidance.

IDSA: official A-Z practice-guideline directory plus April-date indexed search checked; current 2025 entries are not enough to establish this exact week and no new in-window emergency antibiotic guidance was verified.
CHEST: April 1 editor highlights included chronic alpha-1 antitrypsin guidance; April 30 new platelet/plasma transfusion release lies after window; no in-window major CHEST ED guideline verified.

ASH bleeding/anticoagulation: clinical-guideline categories and targeted April-date official search reviewed; Italian aHUS multidisciplinary Delphi (PMID 40204022, Apr 9) was regional rare-disease referral guidance without a new general ED treatment pathway.

Toxicology: ACMT statement date search identified no verified in-window guidance, but official dated chronology incomplete; loperamide case-based toxicokinetic report (PMID 40192347) does not warrant new clinical guidance.

Trauma: previously primary-reviewed ESTES polytrauma consensus first online April 11 retained. EAST ridesharing PMG PMID 40181210 is public-health injury-prevention policy from low-certainty observational evidence, not bedside ED resuscitation.

Pediatrics: primary febrile-neonate CRP/PCT cohort PMID 40250143 used 191 retrospective infants and small 42-infant validation cohort; insufficient to replace AAP infant fever disposition pathways. AAP April book reprints prior policies, not newly issued recommendations.
Obstetrics: hosted ACOG /clinical and dated official document returned HTTP 402; indexed April 17 QI document is later, but primary April 6–12 obstetric guidance search remains incomplete.

Other candidate adjudication: China HAE consensus PMID 40209692 Epub Apr 10 is regional treatment guidance, not new general US ED evidence; multinational LVEF statement PMID 40268622 first public publisher release April 22, not eligible this window. D-dimer DDU retrospective cohort PMID 40262289 lacks prospective management validation; early stress test PMID 40196978 has residual confounding.

Additional candidate appraisal: small uncontrolled sciatica block study PMID 40256350 and short ambulatory-monitoring retrospective cohort PMID 40215590 do not establish treatment/disposition thresholds; diquat severity score PMID 40202468 has limited external validation, and troponin delta cohort PMID 40220709 is retrospective. Selected WESTCOR and ESTES record contents/review labels were preserved.

Cross-journal pediatric sedation RCT PMID 40215365 first online April 11 in Anesthesiology was identified after the four cached journal groups were screened: 253 randomized, transient oxygen desaturation improved with low/high flow, but a 2026 methodological/statistical reassessment (PMID 41982957) was not retrievable; queued for critical appraisal, not yet selected.

excludedCandidates.reason: Small single-center 80-patient TENS RCT for acute low back pain showed modest short-term benefit, but later small randomized evidence was inconsistent; insufficient to prioritize as practice-changing.

Large retrospective association between early noninvasive cardiac testing and 1-year outcomes is vulnerable to residual confounding and conflicts with broader low-risk chest-pain evidence; not selected.
Age-adjusted D-dimer DDU study was retrospective in patients already selected for CTPA and did not prospectively validate a safe diagnostic management strategy; not selected.

Primary Italian aHUS multidisciplinary Delphi consensus Epub Apr 9, 2025: 51 agreed statements emphasize rare-disease recognition/referral and regional multidisciplinary care, not a new general US ED treatment regimen; selectivity exclusion.

Primary Chinese hereditary-angioedema 2024-edition consensus first online Apr 10, 2025 (2026 print); regional drug/access context and no separately verified novel general US ED airway recommendation; exclusion from this selective window.

Publisher Wiley and HFSA first-publication metadata both identify Apr 22, 2025; its April 9 bibliographic date is not eligibility. Move first-online consideration to April 20–26 research window; do not duplicate accompanying cross-journal version PMID 40260636.
Taiwanese febrile neonate CRP/PCT/Rochester retrospective n191 with n42 validation cohort; cannot validate a safe lower-risk neonate disposition pathway or displace existing guideline.
Primary EAST ridesharing practice-management review concerns crash prevention policy (15 observational studies), not ED patient assessment or management.
Prospective 63-person ED sciatic nerve-block study lacked a comparator and cannot establish superiority or a standard ED regimen.
Retrospective short ambulatory-monitoring diagnostic-yield study n491 after ED discharge does not validate safe disposition or a new universal pathway.
Multicenter acute diquat severity-score development and small external validation insufficient for routine triage or validated intervention changes.
Retrospective chest-pain high-sensitivity troponin kinetics study does not establish a new validated prospective discharge decision rule.
Case-based loperamide cardiotoxicity analysis, not new controlled evidence or change to existing ED safety principles.

ACEP carbon monoxide policy was board-approved January 22, 2025; March 22 PubMed bibliographic import preceded April 6–12. April is print issue and exact earliest public electronic date could not be confirmed; do not associate with this research window until authoritative dating verified.
